behaviour.description: A one-layer recurrent network with ReLU and no biases. It reads a sequence of 10 real numbers, one per step, into a hidden state of 16 units, and outputs 10 numbers read from the final state. The inputs are independent standard-normal numbers. Output class i stands for position i of the sequence (0-based).
